root_causes.description: The quote service (leaf dependency of shipping) is the origin: its server request rate is zero and its p99 latency histogram yields no samples across the window, while error rate is flat and the pod stays alive with no crash/OOM events — indicating requests are stuck in-flight due to an injected latency fault rather than failing or crashing. That stall propagates up shipping → checkout → frontend, where checkout p99 saturates at 10000 ms.

evidence.expected_baseline: steady non-zero server request rate for a live leaf service

evidence.observed_value: no samples returned (empty result) — no completed requests in the histogram
evidence.expected_baseline: p99 latency present with valid samples

evidence.observed_value: only benign 'Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage' events; no OOMKilled/BackOff/restart events
evidence.expected_baseline: no crash/restart events for a healthy pod

root_causes.description: shipping directly calls quote and shows the same stalled profile (no p99 latency samples), consistent with being blocked on the in-flight quote requests rather than a fault of its own.

evidence.observed_value: no samples returned (empty result) across the window
evidence.expected_baseline: p99 latency present with valid samples

root_causes.description: checkout is downstream-blocked on shipping→quote and exhibits saturated end-to-end latency, confirming upward propagation of the stall rather than an independent checkout fault.

evidence.observed_value: error_rate mean=0.004, p99=0.021 (near-baseline; latency not errors)

remediation_steps: Inspect the quote pod for an injected latency fault (tc/netem delay or application-level sleep) — it stays alive with flat error rate and no restart/OOM events yet completes zero requests.
Capture shipping→quote client-side spans and add a quote client-latency histogram so the blocked dependency becomes directly measurable.
Temporarily add a request timeout / circuit breaker on the shipping→quote call path to stop the stall from saturating checkout (p99=10000 ms).
Verify recovery by confirming quote server request rate returns to non-zero and checkout p99 drops well below 10000 ms.
